# BBC

> > The British Broadcasting Corporation's regional UK services providing news, sport, culture, and entertainment across Wales, Scotland, and Northern Ireland in multiple languages.

BBC regional services deliver localized content including breaking news, political coverage (Stormont, Welsh affairs), sports (rugby union, local teams like Wrexham and Swansea), and cultural programming. The service includes Welsh-language content via BBC Cymru and Radio Cymru, Scottish Gaelic broadcasting through BBC Alba, and comprehensive regional journalism across all UK nations.

## Key Topics

- Wales
- BBC Wales
- Northern Ireland
- Scotland
- Welsh-language broadcasting
- Radio Cymru

- Stormont politics
- Celtic Connections
- BBC Bitesize
- Wrexham
- Swansea

## Regional Services - Wales

- [BBC Wales - Home](https://www.bbc.com/wales): BBC Wales regional homepage with news, sport, TV shows, and radio content
- [BBC Cymru - Home](https://www.bbc.com/cymru): BBC Cymru Welsh-language homepage featuring Radio Cymru and S4C content

## Regional Services - Scotland

- [BBC Scotland - Home](https://www.bbc.com/scotland): BBC Scotland regional homepage with news, culture, and Scottish content
- [BBC Alba - Home](https://www.bbc.com/alba): BBC Alba Scottish Gaelic broadcasting with Celtic Connections coverage

## Regional Services - Northern Ireland

- [BBC Northern Ireland - Home](https://www.bbc.com/northernireland): BBC NI regional hub covering Stormont politics, sport, and local programs
